title: I’m the Evil Lord of an Intergalactic Empire!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A man who lived honestly but was betrayed by his wife, framed and ruined is offered rebirth by a being called the Guide, who secretly feeds on misery. Reborn as Liam Banfield, lord of a planet in a corrupt interstellar empire, he resolves to be a selfish tyrant, but his long-term plans keep making his domain prosperous and his subjects grateful. The comedy runs alongside dark subplots such as a captured princess knight tortured by pirates.
life_message: Even someone who sets out to be selfish can end up doing good through competence and long-term care for what is his.
